lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A series of high-intensity, roughly circular white spots arranged in staggered vertical columns starting posterior to the gill slits. Centroids form a discernible grid with vertical spacing slightly tighter than horizontal spacing.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Wavy, vertical bands of elevated luminance intersect the primary blobs, acting as anchor nodes for a grid-like pattern across the mid-flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A single prominent horizontal ridge is visible on the upper flank, characterized by a sharp luminance gradient with a highlight on the upper edge and a soft shadow beneath.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A distinct vertical white linear mark is present just posterior to the fifth gill slit.
other_distinctive_markers: Presence of several remoras (Echeneidae) clustered near the ventral surface and pectoral fin insertion point.
